document.title: Statement of Work
document.place_of_performance: Remote support from AIS facilities with client-directed virtual working sessions.

background: Fabrikam Public Gardens needs responsive specialist support for its public-facing digital services.
objectives: Provide a predictable channel for client-directed support.
Improve visibility into support priorities and outcomes.

in_scope.title: Ad hoc support
in_scope.description: Provide client-directed troubleshooting, configuration, and advisory services for the named digital service area.

in_scope.title: Support coordination
in_scope.description: Triage requests and maintain a transparent support queue.

out_of_scope.title: New product delivery
out_of_scope.description: Standalone product development or major roadmap initiatives are excluded.

deliverables.title: Support outcomes
deliverables.description: Completed support requests with resolution notes.
acceptance_criteria: Client confirms the resolution or disposition recorded for each request.

deliverables.title: Support summary
deliverables.description: Periodic summary of requests, outcomes, risks, and recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: Summary is reviewed with the client support owner.

milestones.title: Support launch
milestones.description: Access, queue, and operating cadence are established.

milestones.title: Retainer closeout
milestones.description: Final support summary and transition notes are delivered.

ais.title: Support services
ais.description: AIS will provide qualified staff for approved support requests and report outcomes.

client.title: Direction
client.description: Client will prioritize requests, provide access, and make decisions at or before the weekly governance meeting.

assumptions.title: Support boundary
assumptions.description: Requests remain within the named service area and the client-directed support model.

notes: Retainer fees and any overage rates will be completed through AIS commercial review.
